stories.title: Coleg Cambria manager tackles 1,000-mile challenge for Soul Kitchen Chester
stories.summary: After walking more than 500 miles, Coleg Cambria Work-based Learning Manager Kate Muddiman is appealing for support as she embarks on the second half of an epic 1,000-mile fundraising challenge for a charity close to her heart. stories.title: Three pasta products recalled from Asda and Morrisons over listeria fears

stories.title: University of Chester nursing graduate from Deeside praised by lecturers
stories.summary: A mother of four from Aston has qualified as a nurse with a first-class degree from the University of Chester, after studying while running the family home.
